display.purpose: Nunito Sans headings and wordmark, 700-900 weight.

motion.name: svg-loops
motion.purpose: Seamless household illustration loops; pause offscreen, in dialogs, or on request; static for reduced motion.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Acknowledge an action, then dismiss the toast.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One prominent household action per view.
components.css: .fb-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #6244bd; color: #fff; font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .fb-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bb4f3d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Illustrated Shared Goal
components.description: An original SVG family scene with seamless GSAP motion and an exact state-derived goal ratio. The image is decorative, not a separate score.
components.css: .fb-goal { background: #392146; color: white; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .fb-goal img { width: 100%; height: auto; }

narrative.overview: The user-approved illustration-led family dashboard uses violet framing, teal and coral activity scenes, rounded headings, and original animated SVGs, while preserving all household workflows and real data.

rules.name: Illustrated-Work Rule
rules.body: Color and original artwork give activity tiles character; routine data rows remain readable and quiet.

rules.name: Real-Goal Rule
rules.body: The numeric goal ratio derives from stored state; the decorative scene never introduces a separate score.

dos: Do lead with plans and unfinished chores.
Do preserve SVG fallbacks, pause controls, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't claim weather or calendar integrations that are not connected.
Don't let illustration block routine household actions.
